title: Supply Chain Traceability
thesis: Snowflake builds mill-to-port chain-of-custody with Dynamic Tables, enables auditor self-service via Iceberg/Athena, and enforces buyer-level data segregation — all native SQL, no external blockchain needed

talking_points: One hundred mills tracked — 99.2% of volume traceable to plantation level.
RM 8.9 billion in traced export volume this year. Eight mills below 95% traceability.
Fifty thousand chain-of-custody records maintained in real-time Dynamic Tables.
show: Highlight the 8 mills below threshold on the map
tabs.call_out: 99.2% traceable — but 8 mills below the 95% buyer requirement

transition.line: Let's see which mills have gaps and what's causing them.

talking_points: Full plantation-to-port chain for every tonne of CPO — built automatically by Dynamic Tables.
Shipment SHP-2024-0847: traced from 12 smallholders through Mill Sandakan to Port Klang.
Mass balance reconciliation flags 3 mills with >5% input-output variance.
show: Click shipment SHP-2024-0847 for full chain visualization
Show the mass balance variance table
tabs.call_out: 3 mills failing mass balance — possible leakage or data gaps

transition.line: The chain is mostly intact. Let's check what auditors see.

talking_points: Row Access Policies enforce buyer-level data segregation — Unilever sees only their supply chain.
Iceberg Tables enable auditor self-service via Athena — no Snowflake license needed.
Two hundred audit reports searchable via Cortex Search with severity filtering.
show: Show Row Access Policy in action — toggle between buyer views
Demonstrate Athena query on Iceberg table
tabs.call_out: Buyer data segregation + auditor self-service — zero data leakage

transition.line: Now let the VP ask the system in plain language.

talking_points: Puan Rosnah asks: 'What percentage of our volume is traceable to plantation?'
Cortex Analyst writes the query, returns: 99.2% overall, 8 mills below 95%.
Follow-up: 'What are the top audit findings for mills below 95%?' — agent searches audit reports.
show: Type: 'What is our traceability percentage by mill?'
Switch to advisory mode for audit findings
tabs.call_out: Two AI modes: traceability analytics + audit advisory

talking_points: Seven Snowflake capabilities, six AWS services.
In Snowflake-only mode — Dynamic Tables replace Glue, Row Access Policies replace Lake Formation.
Malaysia's palm oil supply chain: 450 mills, 3M hectares. This traces 100 mills end-to-end.
tabs.call_out: One platform, native SQL, open Iceberg for auditors

transition.line: That's Snowflake and AWS — better together for palm oil traceability.
